# vendor/

This folder holds third-party open source libraries, kept locally so that
everything works offline.

Rules:

- Put one folder per library and version, like `vendor/<name>-<version>/`.
- Include the library's `LICENSE` file (or its equivalent) in that folder.
- Only use permissively licensed code (MIT, BSD, Apache-2.0, ISC, or OFL for
  fonts).
- Add a row to the table below.

| Library | Version | License | Used by |
| ------- | ------- | ------- | ------- |
| *(none yet)* | | | |
